baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath construction in أقسم, the living self in النفس, and recurrent reproach in اللوامة.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath gives evidentiary weight to a living self that turns reproach back upon its own conduct; the intensive adjective makes this monitoring recurrent rather than incidental.

activation_trace.role: The apportioned oath supplies the literal oath and gives the self's reproach the force of testimony.
The living soul-self supplies the enduring subject that both acts and experiences reproach.
Reproach directed at blameworthy conduct supplies the self-correcting action.

changed_reading.before: The ayah names a psyche that feels blame.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a recurrent inner witness whose self-directed reproach is weighty enough to be sworn by.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أقسم and اللوامة are read through the oath's legal-apportioning branch, while النفس remains one whole identity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath root joins division into shares with a legal oath procedure, while blame can pass between parties. Inside one self, these images form an internal hearing that allocates responsibility among competing claims without splitting the accountable identity.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning a thing into shares supplies the allocation of responsibility.
The oath and legal qasama procedure supply the hearing-like frame.
The very thing itself keeps claimant, witness, and respondent within one identity.
Mutual and self-directed blame supplies the adversarial exchange inside that identity.

changed_reading.before: Conscience is a private feeling of remorse.
changed_reading.after: Conscience is an internal proceeding in which one whole self apportions liability and testifies against its own conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch images of a divided mind, hidden intent, and lingering all remain attached to أقسم بالنفس اللوامة.
baseline_models.mechanism: A mind divided among courses turns inward, repeatedly waits, and revisits intention before acting. Alongside moral blame, اللوامة can therefore activate an inhibiting, deliberative self whose recurrence appears as hesitation.

activation_trace.role: A mind divided between courses supplies competing possible actions.
Inner thought and hidden intent locate the competition within the self.
Lingering before action supplies the self's repeated pause and reconsideration.

changed_reading.before: The self blames only after a wrong has occurred.
changed_reading.after: The self also divides over possible courses and repeatedly delays action while hidden intention is still forming.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-dominant ل م م mapping for اللوامة is held beside the focus roots' images of division and whole identity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping lets اللوامة echo gathering and repairing what is scattered. In counterpoint to the apportioning branch of أقسم, the same whole self can be pictured as recollecting its dispersed pieces; this is a branch activation, not a lexical replacement for blame.

activation_trace.role: Division into shares supplies the scattered condition that calls for repair.
The very thing itself supplies the whole identity retained across its dispersed pieces.
Gathering and joining scattered things supplies the counter-motion of recollection and repair.

changed_reading.before: The blaming self is a unitary moral voice.
changed_reading.after: The self is also a gathering operation that repairs and recollects an identity dispersed into shares.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately repeated oath frame pairs the self-reproaching soul with the day of rising. The inward act of standing against oneself becomes a present counterpart to bodily and public rising, so conscience is not merely private remorse but an anticipatory scene of resurrection and account.

activation_trace.role: The focus oath supplies one side of the paired oath construction.
The living soul-self supplies the present inward subject of the pairing.
Self-reproach supplies the inward standing against one's own conduct.
The repeated oath branch makes 75:1 and 75:2 formally coordinate rather than merely adjacent.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour supply the outward event that the inward witness anticipates.

structural_cues: 75:1 and 75:2 repeat لا أقسم بـ in immediate parallel while changing the oath object from the rising day to the reproaching self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated syntax and a resurrection branch for قيامة; I infer that the paired oath objects interpret one another. Alternatively, the repetition may only accumulate two witnesses without making conscience a rehearsal of rising.

changed_reading.before: The ayah isolates an individual's moral psychology.
changed_reading.after: The reproaching self is a present inward counterpart to the future rising, already staging witness and account within the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence turns inward reproach into a temporal evidence system: a report arrives concerning what was advanced and delayed, the self possesses inward sight into its own intent, and excuses cannot displace that knowledge. The self is therefore both an archive of conduct and a competent witness to it.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the evidentiary frame for the later report and testimony.
Hidden thought and intent supply the inward evidence inaccessible to an external inventory alone.
Reproach supplies the evaluative verdict applied to that evidence.
A delivered report supplies the disclosure of the person's record.
Advancing and preceding supply the forward side of the conduct timeline.
Deferring to a later time supplies the delayed or left-behind side of the timeline.
The repeated inner mind and hidden intent branch makes the self the location of privileged evidence.
Insight of the heart supplies the self's competence to read its inward evidence.
Excuse and apology supply the attempted counter-pleading that fails to erase self-knowledge.

structural_cues: 75:13-15 moves from a report of what was advanced and delayed, to the human being's insight over the self, to cast excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, temporal ordering, inward sight, and excuses; I infer a forensic arrow from stored conduct to self-testimony and verdict. Alternatively, the self's sight may expose conduct without itself serving as the reporting archive.

changed_reading.before: The self reproaches through an undefined moral feeling.
changed_reading.after: The self reproaches as an informed witness that sees hidden intent, orders conduct across time, and tests excuses against its own record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same gathering branch recurs over bodily remains, the celestial pair, and recitation. That three-scale repetition strongly activates the focus split-map image of joining what is scattered: the reproaching self can be read as the continuity operation that recollects a dispersed body, world, utterance, and account into one answerable identity.

activation_trace.role: Apportionment supplies the focus ayah's initial image of dispersion into shares.
The very thing itself supplies identity that persists through dispersion and reunion.
The split-map image of joining scattered things supplies the focus-side reassembly operation.
Gathering dispersed things into one supplies bodily reassembly in the question about bones.
The same gathering image expands reassembly from the body to the sun and moon.
The same gathering image extends reassembly to recitation and voiced sequence.

structural_cues: جمع recurs at 75:3, 75:9, and 75:17 over body, heavens, and recitation in that order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one repeated gathering root at three scales and the focus split-map gathering branch; I infer that the repetitions model continuity of answerable identity. Alternatively, each gathering may concern its local object without defining the self's function.

changed_reading.before: The self is a moral voice housed in an already coherent person.
changed_reading.after: The self is also what recollects dispersed material, speech, and deeds into the one identity that can be held to account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Desire aims toward violating a boundary ahead, while love adheres to the immediate and abandons what comes later. This temporal mechanism moves اللوامة from purely retrospective remorse to a recurring threshold response: the inward self contests intention before it becomes a completed rupture.

activation_trace.role: Hidden intent locates the struggle before conduct becomes outward.
Reproach supplies the self's resistance to a blameworthy course.
The split-map image of nearing a minor sin supplies an exploratory threshold before full commission.
Will and desire supply the forward pressure of intention.
Deviation from truth and violation of a covering supply the boundary-crossing toward which desire presses.
Love adhering to the heart supplies the attraction to the immediate.
Hastening and bringing forward supply the temporal bias toward immediate satisfaction.
Leaving a thing supplies the abandonment of the later horizon.

structural_cues: 75:5 places desire and rupture before the human being; 75:20-21 contrasts love of the immediate with leaving the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire, boundary violation, haste, attachment, and abandonment; I infer that recurrent self-reproach can interrupt this sequence before completion. Alternatively, these verses may diagnose the desiring human without assigning conscience a prospective blocking role.

changed_reading.before: The reproaching self reacts after misconduct.
changed_reading.after: The reproaching self is also a prospective threshold that contests hidden desire, haste, and the preference for immediate action before rupture is complete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tongue is restrained from hurried movement, then utterance is gathered, recited, followed, and clarified. Read back into the focus ayah, this sequence disciplines the inner accuser: valid self-reproach is not impulsive self-talk but an audit that receives a gathered account, follows its order, and waits for disclosure before judging.

activation_trace.role: Inner thought and hidden intent supply the inward site where an accusatory account is heard.
Reproach supplies the evaluative speech that the later sequence disciplines.
Movement opposed to stillness supplies the impulsive motion that is restrained.
The tongue as speech organ makes the restrained motion specifically verbal.
Haste and premature advance supply the defect in an immediate verdict.
Gathering scattered material into one supplies a complete evidentiary account.
Reading and recitation supply the ordered voicing of that account.
Following after supplies receptivity to the account's given order.
Disclosing meaning by speech or sign supplies clarification before judgment.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a disciplined sequence for speech; I infer an analogy to how the inward reproaching voice should form a verdict. Alternatively, the sequence may regulate voiced recitation only and have no backward effect on النفس اللوامة.

changed_reading.before: Conscience is an autonomous accusatory voice that speaks as soon as discomfort appears.
changed_reading.after: Conscience is a receptive inner audit whose reproach becomes trustworthy only after evidence is gathered, ordered, followed, and clarified.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus self can denote breath and living soul, while the blame root also carries lingering. The death sequence then supplies arrival at a limit, breath rising at the clavicle, separation, driving, and loss of life-force. Together they activate an embodied reading in which the reproaching self becomes acutely present in the final lingering breath before separation.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body supplies the self's respiratory embodiment.
The living soul-self joins breath to the identity undergoing the terminal passage.
Reproach supplies the moral reckoning that intensifies at the passage.
Lingering and delay supply the interval of a final suspended breath.
Reaching the endpoint supplies the terminal threshold.
The clavicle in which breath rises supplies the concrete respiratory location of the threshold.
Distinguishing and separating two things supplies the break between embodied life and departure.
Driving and urging onward supply the compelled movement beyond the interval.
Departure of power and life supplies the terminal state against which breath and living self are read.

structural_cues: 75:26-30 progresses from reaching the clavicles through recognized separation to a compelled driving; 75:40 closes with restoring life to the dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breath-self branches and a bodily death sequence; I infer that terminal embodiment intensifies self-reproach during the last interval. Alternatively, the sequence may narrate dying without causing any respiratory rereading of النفس اللوامة.

changed_reading.before: The reproaching self is an abstract faculty of conscience.
changed_reading.after: The reproaching self is also embodied as the living breath that lingers at its limit, recognizes separation, and undergoes reckoning as life-force departs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it converges two branch-distant eye senses, one through a non-dominant mapping. It remains anchored because both النفس and the split اللوامة inventory independently supply a harmful striking eye, while later context joins outer sight to inward insight and directed gaze. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory analogy for self-scrutiny that wounds, never as the lexical meaning of النفس اللوامة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: النفس and the split mapping of اللوامة both carry harmful-eye branches, turning the focus construction reflexively inward.

activation_trace.role: The evil eye as a striking breath or self supplies one half of the inwardly harmful gaze.
The split-map harmful striking eye supplies an independent convergence on the same image.
Insight of the heart turns seeing from an external organ into inward apprehension.
Directing sight or insight toward an object supplies the sustained gaze that can be turned back on the self.

changed_reading.before: Self-reproach is heard as an inner verbal accusation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, self-reproach can be pictured as an inward gaze whose scrutiny strikes and marks the same self that looks.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial reading is surprising because the focus ayah names no flight or shelter. It remains valid as a structural activation: the accuser is the person's very identity, and the next movement explicitly seeks escape before denying refuge. Downstream prose should qualify this as an inference about inescapable self-witness, not claim that النفس itself means prison or refuge.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The very self in النفس is also the agent of blame in اللوامة, so flight would require separation from one's own identity.

activation_trace.role: The very thing itself makes the witness inseparable from the identity seeking escape.
Self-directed blame makes that inseparable identity an accuser.
Flight and escape supply the attempted spatial solution to accusation.
Refuge supplies the shelter that the sequence explicitly denies.

changed_reading.before: The reproaching self is one internal voice that might be ignored or escaped.
changed_reading.after: Because the witness is the person's very self, its testimony is carried wherever the person flees and admits no external refuge.

strongest_changes: The paired oath syntax makes the reproaching self a present inward counterpart to resurrection and standing.
The report-self-insight-excuse sequence turns remorse into forensic self-testimony across a timeline of conduct.
Repeated gathering of body, celestial pair, and recitation activates an exploratory model of the self as continuity and reassembly.
Desire for rupture and love of the immediate move reproach from after-the-fact regret toward prospective resistance at the threshold of action.
The terminal sequence re-embodies النفس as living breath that lingers, separates, and is driven onward.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package did more than add judgment imagery: repeated structures changed the scale and timing of the focus ayah. The same self became present rehearsal of rising, archive and witness, gatherer of dispersed identity, disciplined receiver of an account, and finally embodied breath at the edge of separation.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle the grammatical force of لا in the repeated oath construction.
Readings based on the non-dominant ل م م mapping remain exploratory even where later gathering strongly activates them.
The backward link from the recitation sequence to the inner reproaching voice is a reader-supplied analogy, not an explicit syntactic relation.
The terminal-breath reading depends on carrying a branch image of النفس into a later bodily sequence rather than on a repeated focus phrase.
